description: This file defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) entity in a wireless communication stack, including classes for handling PDCP RX lower interface, upper data notifier, control notifier, and control interface.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for the lower layer to pass PDUs into the PDCP entity.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_data_notifier
classes.description: Interface for passing SDUs from PDCP to upper layers.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers of protocol or integrity failures.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for configuring security and control operations of the RX PDCP.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handle the incoming PDU from lower layers.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Notify upper layers of a new SDU.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Notify when maximum count is reached.

methods.name: configure_security
methods.description: Configure security parameters for the PDCP.

methods.name: reestablish
methods.description: Trigger re-establishment with new security config.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notify that PDU processing has stopped.
